specification.objective: Restore readable task titles in the backlog while retaining accessible row actions after interaction targets were enlarged.

requirements.statement: At a 1440 logical-pixel viewport, a backlog row with all available actions reserves at least 160 logical pixels for its task title.
All existing detail, reorder, edit, delete, and assignee actions remain permission-aware and keyboard/touch accessible with at least 48 by 48 logical-pixel targets.

acceptance_criteria.statement: With all row actions enabled at a 1440-pixel viewport, the title text area is at least 160 pixels wide and the backlog has no layout exception.
All row actions remain reachable through 48 by 48 pixel controls, retain their permissions/disabled states, and invoke their existing callbacks.
docs/contracts/workspace-visual-consistency-v2.polis.json is byte-for-byte identical to the locked contract.

invariants.statement: Preserve the existing backlog columns, row data, labels, callback behavior, permission checks, busy-state behavior, routing, API calls, and persistence.
Do not reduce any interactive target below 48 by 48 logical pixels or add dependencies.

forbidden_states.statement: Row actions consume so much of the title cell that the title area is narrower than 160 pixels at the specified viewport.
Any existing row action becomes inaccessible, permission-inappropriate, or loses its callback or busy-state handling.

inputs.statement: Backlog viewport, task rows, permission flags, busy state, and available row actions.

outputs.statement: Readable task titles and accessible row actions in the backlog.

failure_semantics.statement: Widget regression tests fail with a labeled backlog_title_minimum_width assertion or an action/target mismatch when the contract is violated.

argv: production themes keep backlog controls compact and responsive
production themes keep backlog controls compact and responsive
